name: Scotia Momentum Visa Infinite Card

apr.notes: 20.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash advances, balance transfers and cash-like transactions.

credit_required.notes: Minimum personal income of $60,000, household income of $100,000, or $250,000 in assets under management.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other eligible purchases and on accelerated categories after the annual spend limit.

categories.label: Grocery and recurring bill payments (up to $25,000 annual spend)
Gas, EV charging, transit, rideshare and food delivery (up to $25,000 annual spend)

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is deposited to the account once a year in November.

signup_bonus.description: Welcome offer of 15% cash back on up to $2,000 in purchases in the first 3 months, with the first-year annual fee waived when offered.

notes: Network tier is Visa Infinite per the card name.
